keyFindings.description: Round 2 finding 2 still stands when the owner has a host bridge. Ownership now follows the stored subscription (session.go:82), so a session that re-registered through B keeps A as its owner. But hostFor returns ENVOY_HOST_BRIDGE whenever one is set, so A dials its own machine's bridge for a session now running on B's machine. Every compose host listener sets ENVOY_HOST_BRIDGE=127.0.0.1. Measured: TestARehomedSessionStillReceivesItsStoredTopicOnce, run through a go overlay with the first listener on ENVOY_HOST_BRIDGE=127.0.0.2, gave no prompt in 10 s. A logged ERROR 'listener delivery failed ... Post http://127.0.0.2:<port>/session/<id>/prompt_async: dial tcp 127.0.0.2:<port>: connect: connection refused' and NAKed. The committed test passes only because its listeners have no bridge. Round 1's rule took the bridge only for a session whose entry names this listener (or none); before this PR, A dialled B's machine name. Required: the bridge only for a session registered through this listener, else the recorded host, and the re-home test run with a bridge on the first listener.
